question: What Il22ra1 and Il10rb transcript detection and count-derived abundance occur in retained Choi cells within each saved library and literal pipeline label?
decision: Qualify the saved benchmark as a descriptive transcript source, including sparse coverage and empty labels; do not select interventions or infer response.
strongest_rival: Sparse capture, ambient signal, library/time confounding, cell selection and annotation error can shape observed transcript patterns without receptor activity or valid biological-state attribution.
discriminator: Report two fixed transcripts for every source label/library, preserving absent labels and transparent cell/count denominators; arithmetic checks cannot distinguish ambient RNA from cell-intrinsic signal.
exposure_record: Prior source outcomes, labels, composition and marker evidence were reviewed. C0 inspected H5AD schema, exact feature identities and ordered metadata joins without reading count data, X or feature means/variances. The two transcript values were not inspected during C0; historical exposure is not erased. Only synthetic values were used for code/tests and figure-layout review before freeze.
biological_unit: Retained cell is the measurement unit. Each saved library pools two mice; animal-level observations are unavailable.
nesting_and_overlap: Cells nest in three saved pooled libraries with one library per condition. Labels and both transcripts reuse these same cells. All-retained and non-contaminant aggregates overlap label strata; no independent animal replication.
population_and_selection: All 11683 retained cells and all 27998 saved feature counts from the exact frozen Choi matrix. Preserve literal labels, including contaminants. Add explicit empty rows for pAT2, unassigned and contaminant_endothelium, which are declared by the source rule but absent here.
contrast: No condition, time, gene-ranking or treatment contrast. Descriptive tabulation within each saved library and literal label, plus separate ALL_RETAINED and NON_CONTAMINANT aggregates.
endpoint: For each fixed gene and stratum: n cells, n with count >0, detection fraction, summed gene counts, summed counts across all saved features, and 1e6 * gene-count sum / all-feature-count sum. Count bins 0, 1 and >=2 qualify sparsity only.
methods: Read only layers/counts CSR and saved metadata using h5py, NumPy and SciPy. Require canonical finite positive integer sparse entries and exact per-cell totals. Exact symbol mapping uses Il22ra1 then Il10rb. Summed counts use int64. Abundance is a ratio of sums over the same cells, not a mean of per-cell normalized values and not normalization to all cells outside the stratum. Display all 11 source labels followed by two aggregates, in the three predefined library columns. Plot detection on a common 0-100 percent scale; abundance colors use log10(1+counts per million), with raw values annotated. Display cell denominators and literal labels; no trajectories or response scores.
missingness_and_exclusions: No additional cell or gene exclusions, source preprocessing or label changes. NON_CONTAMINANT uses only not state.startswith(contaminant_); unassigned remains included. Empty strata have n_cells=0 and all count/detection/abundance endpoints unavailable (CSV blanks), not biological zeros. Populated strata with no detection retain measured zero counts. No small-stratum threshold or pseudocount in numerical endpoints; plot transform is display-only.
multiplicity: Two prespecified genes in fixed order; no tests, confidence intervals, target selection or multiple-testing procedure.
precision_basis: Finite saved-cell descriptive counts only. No cell bootstrap, animal-level confidence interval or population precision claim; sparse groups retain their explicit denominators.
interpretation_limit: Saved counts do not establish receptor protein, signaling, cytokine responsiveness, cell identity, memory, lineage, repair, intervention effects or animal-level variation. Shared-source reanalysis is not independent replication; non-detection is not biological absence. All original Saxton biological execution holds remain unchanged.
stop_rule: Stop on input/hash mismatch, missing/ambiguous fixed symbols, unsupported schema, missing metadata, incorrect ordered joins, altered source denominators, noncanonical/noninteger counts, saved-total disagreement or existing output artifacts. Preserve failed receipts and use a versioned amendment for corrections. Stop affected scope on any new content restriction; no replacement session, excluded analysis or target expansion.
amendment_reason: New bounded exposed descriptive question E1a under the reviewed plan; not a restart or amendment of held R2/R3 biological analyses. Source outputs remain immutable.
